scope: First frozen evaluation on pre-reserved wrapper/h3/h4/reverse-entry compositions. The clean committed model, actual Rawstep inputs/previous contexts and predictions were fixed before either Native browser. Input verification includes complete compound unit semantics and actual Native disclosure level; physical AX node/DOM-ID comparisons remain separate diagnostics and are not logical-cursor Navigation Accuracy. Final enabled state is fixture health, not user-task success. Both profiles finish before inspecting outcomes. Small synthetic reading-only cohort, now regression; no web-wide, navigation, task or queue/timing parity claim.

plan.sourceState: Model JS comes from the retained, clean c78533b tarball. Observer/generator source hashes describe the collection worktree with earlier pending diagnostics; these do not identify the model source.
plan.question: Do the corrected measured linked-heading input projection and hint roles transfer to pre-reserved transparent-wrapper h3/h4 units and reverse-entry histories?
plan.hypothesis: Preserve a complete equal-name compound unit and activation-link identity independently of the physical outline. Hint role follows the outer unit; Chrome inner-link heading exposes a separately measured zero-based disclosure level. Fix actual inputs and predictions before Native and inspect after both profiles finish.
plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. For the Native verifier only, join the actual model target backendDOMNodeId to its independently read renderer DOM id; retain both original identity and mapping. This ID-only verification view does not alter model input or prediction. Container IDs retain actual model identities. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.
metrics: literal Full Speech Exact of actual model windows
plan.limits: Pre-reserved new wrapper/heading-level/reverse-entry compositions. Not a representative web cohort; all cases become regression after this first evaluation. The unchanged enabled-state oracle only checks fixture health, not task-generalization performance. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.

acquisition.scope: Clean c78533b package model; pre-reserved unchanged wrapper/h3/h4/reverse-entry inputs. No model/source modifications or outcome inspection before both Native profiles complete. Observer worktree retains older pending evaluator diagnostics, independently snapshot and hashed.
